title: Linear-Time Triangulation of Simple Polygons (Chazelle's Algorithm) in Lean 4
summary: A formalization and provably correct implementation of a linear-time algorithm for triangulating a simple polygon. The implementation is a concrete program for an explicit exact real RAM. Lean proves that on every simple polygon with n vertices the program halts within C(n+1) steps, with natural-number words at most K(n+1), and outputs a conforming triangulation with exactly n - 2 triangles on the input vertices.
